chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 560: A Fiery Prodigy is Born and War Escalates
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning and Yu Wei welcome their daughter Brightmoon, a Fiendgod-born prodigy. Meanwhile, Daofather Crimsonbright learns the Seamless Gate has deployed a Daofather puppet.
og_title: Ji Ning Becomes a Father – Brightmoon Arrives!
og_description: The birth of Brightmoon brings joy to Brightheart Island, but Daofather Crimsonbright receives grim news of a Daofather puppet on the battlefield.
twitter_title: Behold, Brightmoon! Ji Ning’s daughter is born.
twitter_description: A cute breather chapter of family warmth, followed by Daofather Crimsonbright’s warning about a Seamless Gate escalation.

lore_anchors.definition: An immensely powerful puppet treasure crafted at the Daofather level, representing a major strategic escalation in Realm Wars. Its refining requires colossal resources and is a sign of desperation or overwhelming ambition.
A Xianxia concept representing a realm’s accumulated destiny, luck, and spiritual prosperity. Losing it makes a world vulnerable to external conquest.
The personal domain of the Lord of All Demons, a hidden and secure location where the most powerful and secret puppets for the Seamless Gate are crafted.
